I'm Sorry, Shona

My Shona,

I know I hurt you, and I'm truly sorry. I don't want to make excuses or brush aside what you feel. Your feelings matter to me, and you deserve to be heard, understood, and loved with care.

If I could rewind that moment, I would do things differently. I can't change what happened, but I can take responsibility for it and try to be better—not just with words, but with the way I treat you every day.

You are so precious to me, Shona. I'm sorry for making your heart heavy when I should be one of the people who makes it feel safe and happy.

Please take the time you need. I won't pressure you to forgive me before you're ready. I just wanted you to know that I love you, I'm sorry, and I want to make things right.

Forever your Lulu,
❤️

Can I try to make your smile bloom again?

❤️
A promise from Lulu

Thank you, Shona.

Can I have a hug when you're ready? 🥺

Made with love, for my Shona.
